bestBets.overview: As is usually the case at the 'Sunshine Coast' there are showers about. Thursday and Friday to be exact. Dare say the track remains soft. Eight races to be decided, rail out 2m. Kick things off with a 2200m C1. Just no's 4 and 7 looked to be the pace, both have declined that distinct advantage. I've narrowed this down to two decent chances. The Renita Beaton trained AMELIORATION and the Daiki Chujo trained JUNOSTAR. Can never be too confident with these restricted class stayers but these two shall do me. The former saves best for this track. The latter comparatively lightly raced and a last start winner which was also its first attempt at the distance.

raceTips.comment: DURNESS proved too good last start over 2010m at Toowoomba. Strong through the line, she looks a genuine stayer and the rise to 2200m will suit. JUNOSTAR comes off a maiden win over 2200m at Grafton. It was her first time stepping out past 1900m and she looks well placed here to strike again. SEALORD won very well over 2020m at the Gold Coast in July but has failed to feature in two subsequent runs when dropping back in trip. I think he’ll relish getting out to this journey and Bella Youngberry will take 1.5kgs off. AMELIARATION saluted over 1800m two runs back but was only plain last time. She does race well here and may just be looking for that extra distance.

bestBets.overview: 1000m QTIS 3yo Maiden Hcp. Sixteen can run, of course that was highly unlikely and here we are on the morning of and sure as eggs it won't be a thing. Free tip to whom it may concern. Unless the stakes are high the yards just aren't interested in big fields from this start.  Kendrick was good for three, two remain. C & C Munce and Heathcote were both good for two, now one apiece. Four will be on debut, two will be 1st-up from a spell. A race where you hope the betting assists. That theory was blown out of the water when Cyber Boom won here on debut on Sunday.  So as was the case on Sunday I shall suggest who I believe is here with a show, but ignore the fluc's. BETTY'S BOY, BODMIN MOOR, BOOTS, and POETIC BELLE topped my list, two of them have opted out.

raceTips.comment: BOOTS returns off a lengthy break. He was well supported on debut following an impressive trial win but weakened late and pulled up with heat stress. He was strong through the line in a recent trial here and gets Ben Thompson to steer off a low draw. PIERANTES makes her debut. She’s been readied for this with three Doomben trials and gets the blinkers on. BODMIN MOOR resumes. He wasn’t far away in his two starts last campaign and showed enough to suggest he’ll be winning races. He’s trialled up well but does have the wide draw to contend with. POETIC BELLE debuts. She worked to the line well in a recent Doomben trial behind the smart Olivoni and she looks ready to go.

bestBets.overview: 1000m C5. No's 6 & 7 the speed, 5 can stalk. TONNEOFGRIT had excuses 1st-up at Doomben, races well here. BONDED AFFAIR excels here, especially at the 1000m - Track+Distance: 6:3:1:1 -  no idea why they ever put him in a float. Must be free petrol/diesel about? James Healy saddles up two - the resuming STREAK OF WINNING and CHALICE WELL. The latter strips fitter, maps a treat, and is also proven here. KING OF THE JUNGLE on the seven day back-up, maps to take plenty of running down. CUSTO keeps finding the line, goes in all exotics.

raceTips.comment: TONNEOFGRIT blew the start and then got caught wide when resuming in open company at Doomben. Fitter, he drops back in grade and he loves it here at the Sunshine Coast. BONDED AFFAIR was slow away but strong through the line last start at Eagle Farm. He excels here at his home track and can bounce back. CHALICE WELL did enough when resuming over 1100m at Doomben. Fitter, the 1000m here suits and she’s sure to find this easier. FLYWHEEL resumes for the new yard. He’s likely to find them too sharp over the 1000m but is proven fresh and will be strong late.

bestBets.overview: 1600m BM70. Map says no's 1,6,10,14 will settle up there in transit. There's three I care to consider. BOONDOCKS is one for one here, looks to be working up to a win, 4th run in for the campaign hence can be ready to peak. Just needs a confident ride out of the gates or may wind up last and/or wide with the remaining pace grinning from ear muff to ear muff. WRIGLEY FIELD is having first start on the track but drops back in grade and should be very competitive. MISHANI WITNESS is racing well and draws the best, looked a proper hope as well, now out.

raceTips.comment: WRIGLEY FIELD is racing well but was a touch plain last time at Eagle Farm. Hard fit, he should this easier than what he’s been contesting and Ryan Maloney sticks with him. TORO STRIKE is a new addition to the Jack Bruce yard. He was good through the line last start after settling at the rear and has since trialled to keep him up to the mark. The rise in trip looks ideal and he’s yet to miss a top three spot in five runs here. BOONDOCKS is racing well and presents at peak fitness. He boasts a strong record over the mile and has won at his only start here. He’ll just need luck from the wide gate. HOLY FLASH is racing well but just had no luck in the straight last start at Ipswich. He’ll appreciate getting back on the big track here and the rise in trip should suit.

bestBets.overview: 1200m C3 Plate. All sixteen can run but with two sleeps to go that wasn't gunna happen. No's 4,7,10,13,16 look to be the pace. Was wary of the freshened KADALL, it's also now out. LIMERO fitter for two from a spell, unlayable both hence the market will be my guide from now on. RAZORS fitter for two from a spell, excuses 2nd-up, this is a drop in class and the map looks good. COL BURN overcame a wide draw when saluting fresh, making it two from two here at home. VIN SANTO has settled in nicely for Renita Beaton, winning fresh then game in defeat 2nd-up. Sting out will suit. CUTEPI should have finished closer at Doomben, 4th run in here, one of the better chances.  MISS FUNNY HONEY place claims for them wide exotics.

raceTips.comment: RAZORS resumed with a solid effort to finish third at Doomben but weakened late last time when stepping out to 1350m. Freshened, he drops back in trip, the blinkers go on and gate six should see him afforded every chance. KADALL returns. He’s been placed in five of six first up appearances and this looks a nice race for him to kick off. He does draw a bit sticky but if he can find cover early, he’ll be strong late. COL BURN has won two of his three starts and looks to have plenty of upside. It was a tough first up effort under 61kgs and whilst he does rise in grade, he strips fitter. CUTEPI is a very capable mare but does herself no favours. The blinkers come off, Michael Rodd stays aboard and if there’s genuine speed on, she’ll be charging home late.

bestBets.overview: 1200m Maiden Plate. Sixteen can run, you can guess the rest. Heinrich & Rodgers are good for three of the twelve. One of them is without a rider! Kendrick is good for two. 50% of the field from just two yards!  No's 9 and 17 at the very least look to be the pace. Looks an easy race to win. The resuming new blood STORMING HOME can be the one. Jack Bruce making quite a name for himself, especially with the 'rejects' from NSW. He gets them to go, makes fools of those who show them the stable door  in the process, my word he does. EMBER ROYALE made good improvement 2nd start, this looks easier. The resuming SPIRIT OF TORQUE boasts decent form, shouldn't remain a maiden for much longer.

raceTips.comment: STORMING HOME resumes for the new stable. She failed to fire on debut at Kembla Grange but looked good finding the line in a recent Doomben trial and the 1200m kick off will suit. PROPHET OF DESTINY has been the runner up at his past two starts and looks nearing a win. Back to 1200m suits and if they run along in front, he’ll be very strong late. SPIRIT OF TORQUE resumes. She was a narrow runner up in consecutive starts last preparation before tackling stakes races. She does draw wide but will be doing her best work late. KIAVELA found the line strongly last start over 1200m at Beaudesert. She may be looking for further now but she’ll enjoy getting out onto the big track.

bestBets.overview: 1800m BM60. Up to five of the eight could have designs on setting the pace, no's 2,3,6,9,10. Sets up well for the Phil Bobic trained GOT YOURSELF A GUN which came to hand quickly when bolting in 2nd-up over the Toowoomba 'mile'. Boris Thornton was aboard the 6yo for the first time there, he sticks like glue. WEEKEND ARTIST was my 2nd pick, ain't running. For one reason or another nothing else made as much appeal to me. And that remains the case.

raceTips.comment: GOT YOURSELF A GUN needed the run when resuming but proved too good second up over the mile at Toowoomba. With the added fitness, the rise to 1800m will suit. OLD FAITHFUL is racing in top form, having won two of his past three starts. The drop back to 1800m isn’t ideal but he’s hard fit and can roll forward and take catching. SHAPE OF WATER comes off a much improved effort over 1800m at the Gold Coast. He gets the inside draw and any give in the track will only enhance his chances. BROOKLYN DAISY hasn’t been far away in recent runs and she’ll enjoy getting back onto her home track. She performs well here and can figure.

bestBets.overview: 1800m Maiden Plate. No's 5,8,9,11 look set to settle forward. KOWLOON MAGNATE is the new blood. Scratched from what looked a suitable race at Ipswich on Wednesday and sure did when you reflect on where the winner settled. Right where this would have been jogging along. That created a winning change of tactics for Waller. Hope he sends the Archibald's a Xmas Card! To be fair this is easier and it could be this yard wants an easy-kill more so than a proper chance with the risk of running a place only. And of course stables can afford to be fussy in the era of eight emergencies etc etc.  Not sure what to next suggest, they are a limited lot. BRASS BAND hates to place and could do so yet again.

raceTips.comment: BOBBY’S MY MATE settled back at the tail last start over 1800m and closed off strongly to claim fourth. Lightly raced, he’s improving with each run and he should be able to settle within striking distance here. KOWLOON MAGNATE has been placed at his past four starts and looks nearing a win. The way he found the line last start over the mile suggests the rise in trip will suit. BRASS BAND is another that racing consistently. Placed at his past six starts, he’s hard fit and if he can see out the 1800m, he’ll be right in this. BARTLE FRERE was good through the line last start at the Gold Coast. He’s fit and can certainly figure.
